step1_analysis.description: A transconductance (Gm) cell used in a low-IF active complex filter. It features multiple cross-coupled and cascode branches for nonconventional tuning of the filter's center frequency and bandwidth, converting differential I/Q inputs into differential currents.

voltage_gain.description: Low-frequency voltage gain of the Gm cell (with artificial 10k load)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using square law model with SKY130 parameters and 10k ohm load.

dc_power.description: DC power consumption of the cell

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2 * pi * Rload * Cout). Cout ~ 50fF. BW = 1 / (2 * pi * 10k * 50fF) = 318 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Bandwidth is determined by the artificial 10k load and parasitic capacitances. It must be well above the 2 MHz IF.

phase_shift.description: Phase shift at the IF frequency (2 MHz)

sky130_expected.calculation: At low frequencies, the phase shift of an inverting amplifier is 180 degrees. Since we measure V(N3)-V(N4) for V(IN+)-V(IN-), it should be around 180 degrees.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard inverting differential pair behavior at frequencies well below the bandwidth.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC voltage gain, bandwidth, phase shift, and transient response of the complex filter Gm cell.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Active Complex Filter Gm Cell
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u

XM1 N3 N3 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N4 LABEL_NET_0 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N3 N4 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N1 LABEL_NET_1 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N6 LABEL_NET_2 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N3 LABEL_NET_3 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N5 LABEL_NET_4 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N0 N6 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N4 LABEL_NET_5 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N7 LABEL_NET_6 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N2 LABEL_NET_7 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N3 N0 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N0 N4 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 N0 LABEL_NET_8 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}

* Pull-up resistors for open-drain outputs
R1 N3 N0 10k
R2 N4 N0 10k

* Power supply (N0 is VDD)
VVDD N0 0 1.8

* Bias and Tuning Voltages
V_bias_tail LABEL_NET_7 0 0.9
V_tune0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
V_tune3 LABEL_NET_3 0 0.9
V_tune5 LABEL_NET_5 0 0.9
V_tune8 LABEL_NET_8 0 0.9

* Differential Inputs (I channel)
V_IN_I_P LABEL_NET_1 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5 SIN(0.9 0.1 2Meg)
V_IN_I_N LABEL_NET_4 0 DC 0.9 AC -0.5 SIN(0.9 -0.1 2Meg)

* Differential Inputs (Q channel)
V_IN_Q_P LABEL_NET_2 0 DC 0.9 AC 0
V_IN_Q_N LABEL_NET_6 0 DC 0.9 AC 0

* VCVS to convert differential output to single-ended for easy measurement
E_diff out_diff 0 N3 N4 1.0

.control
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  ac dec 100 1k 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(out_diff)
  let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(out_diff))
  
  meas ac midband_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=(midband_gain-3) fall=1
  meas ac phase_at_IF find phase at=2Meg
  
  tran 10n 2u
  meas tran vout_max max v(out_diff)
  meas tran vout_min min v(out_diff)
  
  quit
.endc
